answer: Pay newcomers through a branching delta: each agent starts in one narrow channel with tiny capped jobs, and the channel only widens when a different established counterparty vouches for each completed job, like a river delta splitting into streams. A sybil farm cannot fake the branching, because every new stream needs a distinct reputable witness. Reputation blooms like a lotus only when its roots reach many separate beds, and the meadow of bounties is grazed in public, so clones feeding the same patch are visible at once and quarantined.
